summary.intent: Push a CI-related change to a remote branch and create a pull request for the cipher-box repository.
summary.outcome: PR #450 was created, then the commit type was amended from 'chore(ci)' to 'fix(ci)' to ensure release-please triggers a version bump and new tag for deployment.

repo: The repo uses release-please for versioning; 'chore' commits do not trigger a version bump or new release tag, while 'fix' commits trigger a patch bump.
Deployment retries depend on a new release tag being present, so the commit type directly affects CI/CD retry capabilities.

code.finding: File was modified as part of this CI-related change.

workflow: Commit type selection (chore vs fix vs feat) has downstream consequences on release automation — always verify whether a change needs to be deployable before choosing 'chore'.
Amending a commit after PR creation is needed when the conventional commit type is wrong and release automation depends on it.

friction: Commit type was initially chosen as 'chore(ci)' without considering the release-please versioning impact, requiring an amend after the PR was already created.
